text:
Maria: Quick sync — proposing new regression gate logic for onboarding quantized candidates. TL;DR: tighten QA_F1 delta to -1.5% (absolute) and allow up to +5% PPL delta only if hallucination/factuality checks pass. Need a quick ✅ before I update the harness config.

Raj: Sounds reasonable. Do we have a prioritized prompt set that captures tail behavior? want to avoid blind spots.

Oliver: I made a stratified set yesterday: prompts/priority/edge_cases.yaml (covers numeric tables, long-context, multi-step). Ran a quick smoke on candidate-quant-4bit — posting numbers below.

Tess: Paste the command and raw output? also confirm random seeds/sampling so runs are comparable.

eval-bot: run finished — id: abc123
metrics summary (baseline -> candidate):
- QA_F1: 88.1 -> 86.3 (delta -2.0%)
- PPL: 12.0 -> 12.5 (delta +4.2%)
- Hallucination rate (auto check): 1.8% -> 3.9%

Maria: With the -1.5% limit that would be a hard fail. Hallucination jump is concerning too.

Oliver: Note: that run used default sampling seed. No hallucination-focused suite yet. I'll re-run with the explicit factuality harness and fixed seeds.

Raj: A suggested gate policy:
- numeric thresholds:
  - QA_F1 delta must be >= -1.5% (if worse => reject)
  - PPL delta tolerated up to +5% ONLY if hallucination delta <= +1.0pp and human sample checks pass
- qualitative checks:
  - Run factuality suite (prompts/factuality.yaml) and manual review of 30 stratified examples
  - If hallucination > 2.0% automatic fail unless manual triage explains root cause
- rollout override:
  - If numeric fail but qualitative pass, allow 1% canary behind FF for 48h with telemetry hooks

Tess: +1 to that. One ops ask: add a clear fall-back model route and automatic rollback if canary error-rate or latency regress > threshold.

Oliver: Re-run command I'm using:
```
./harness/run_eval.py \
  --model candidate-quant-4bit \
  --prompts prompts/priority/edge_cases.yaml,prompts/factuality.yaml \
  --metrics qa_f1,ppl,halluc_rate \
  --seed 42 \
  --samples 3 \
  --out /tmp/candidate_abc123.json
```

eval-bot: re-run submitted => id: abc124 (queued on dedicated infra). ETA ~ 30m.

Maria: If abc124 still fails the numeric gate, we'll mark candidate as HOLD and add to "quant-retry" board. If passes numerics but fails factuality, we require a repair plan (quantization tweaks or KV-cache fp16).

Tess: Also add a required note in the harness: which prompt subsets failed (so engineers get immediate feedback).

Maria: I'll open a PR to update the harness gating logic + add the new threshold fields. Draft config snippet in PR description:

```
"gates": {
  "qa_f1_delta": -1.5,
  "ppl_delta_tolerance": 5.0,
  "hallucination_delta_allowance": 1.0,
  "manual_sample_count": 30,
  "canary_policy": { "traffic_pct": 1, "duration_hours": 48 }
}
```

Raj: LGTM. small nit: call it "hallucination_delta_pp" so it's clearer.

deploy-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/456 — tagged @Maria @Raj @Tess. CI will run the gating harness once merged.

Maria: Thanks — I'll wait for abc124 and then update the PR if we need to loosen/tighten any numbers. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the proposed policy so I can land it after the re-run.

Oliver: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
Tess: :thumbsup:
